answer: Random Beacon Identity Threading. Each agent's identity must extend a thread seeded by a public verifiable-randomness beacon; the next link commits to hash(prior link, beacon output), so identities cannot be built before the beacon fires. A prism of per-epoch proofs splits each identity into fresh sub-keys, and a sonnet of rotating beacon rounds forces live participation. An attacker must run an agent through every beacon epoch in real time, paying full liveness and compute per identity with no precomputation possible.
